units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:1">Sot. VIII, 1</cite> <he>צ׳ חרבות</he> the brandishing of the enemy’s swords. Mekh. B’shall. s. 2 <he>כנגד צ׳ חרבות שלהן</he> this (the lightning) corresponds to their (the Egyptians’) brandishing their swords; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 160:2">Yalk. Sam. 160</cite> <he>כנגד צ׳ הזין</he>.—Pl. <he>צִחְצוּחִין</he> (or <he>צַחְ׳</he>).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 13</cite> <he>חזר פרעה והביא מיני צ׳ של ברזל … מצוחצחין</he> again Pharaoh brought up various kinds of glistening iron (steel) armor, and the Lord brought lightnings which are glistening.

<cite ref="Yevamot 105a:19">Yeb. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>אי אפשר לדם בלא צ׳ רוק</he> it is not possible to spit blood without a solution of saliva in it.—Pl. constr. <he>צִחְצוּחֵי</he>, <cite ref="R00030"><he>צִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 25a:14">B. Kam. 25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 22a:25">Nidd. 22ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>צ׳ זיבה</he> dilution of the gonorrheal discharge.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35a:11">Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ חלב</he> particles of diluted milk (in the holes of cheese).

<cite ref="Shabbat 144b:10">Sabb. 144ᵇ</cite> <he>לפי … בלא צ׳ שמן</he> because it is impossible for the serial fluid of olives not to contain particles of diluted oil; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:3">Tosef. Toh. X, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00456"><he>מוֹחַל</he></cite>.
